resources.title: What Is Account Abstraction? ERC-4337 Wallets Explained
resources.tldr: A clean walk through what ERC-4337 changes about who pays gas, who signs, and what a wallet is allowed to be. Good grounding before anything agent-related makes sense.

resources.title: Agent Wallets Compared: Crossmint, Privy, Turnkey, Coinbase
resources.tldr: Long side-by-side of the main agent wallet providers. Vendor-authored, but detailed enough on key custody and spending limits to serve as a map of what this category has to solve.

resources.title: Agentic Commerce Use Cases: 5 Examples That Work Today
resources.tldr: Short and deliberately unambitious: five things agents can actually transact for right now, which is a useful corrective to the broader speculation.
